items.title: Adult epilepsy market to reach $17.bn across 7MM by 2035
items.summary: The adult epilepsy market across the 7MM is poised to grow at a CAGR of 4.4% from $11.4bn in 2025 to $17.8bn in 2035.

items.title: Sanofi abandons eczema drug approval efforts in another blow to OX40 class
items.summary: Sanofi is ceasing development of amlitelimab due to concerns around the drug's differential value from other eczema treatment offerings.

items.title: BeOne to invest $300m in US manufacturing facility expansion
items.summary: BeOne Medicines is set to invest $300m in expanding its manufacturing and research operations at the Princeton West Innovation Campus in Hopewell, New Jersey, US.

items.title: FDA grants fast track designation for Lundbeck’s Lu AH69593
items.summary: Lundbeck has secured fast track designation from the US FDA for its investigational treatment, Lu AH69593, to treat narcolepsy.

items.title: GSK secures first lung cancer approval, validating $10.6bn Nuvalent bet
items.summary: GSK's newly approved ROS1-positive NSCLC drug, Jideytro will now enter a lung cancer niche dominated by Pfizer’s Lorbrena.
